fields.description: Nad Al Sheba Gardens is a gated residential community in Dubai with townhouses and detached villas released in several phases. The collection spans three-bedroom townhouses and four- to seven-bedroom villas. This profile keeps phase-specific layouts, launch prices and payment calendars separate rather than treating the whole community as one release.

overview: Phase 7 includes two- and three-level townhouse arrangements. Its reviewed villas use additional family rooms and service spaces; room labels and outdoor illustrations should be checked against the selected contract rather than inherited across the community.
research.locationNote: The community is in Nad Al Sheba, Dubai, with access to Meydan and the wider city road network. Phase and plot must be confirmed before assigning exact home coordinates or a view.
research.priceNote: The current official family page displays a reference from AED 5m, not a quote for a specific release. The Phase 7 launch sheet lists AED 4.43m/10.78m/12.66m/16.12m/20.90m for three-bedroom townhouses and four/five/six/seven-bedroom villas respectively. Phase 10 separately lists 5.1m/11.4m/13.9m/17.7m/24.8m. These historical tiers do not establish current stock or interchangeable prices.
research.paymentNote: The table below is only the original Phase 7 three-to-five-bedroom 80/20 schedule. Phase 7 six/seven-bedroom homes instead use 20% booking, then 10%, 5%, 10%, 5%, 5%, 5% through July 2027 and 40% August 2028. Phase 10 has separate dated 80/20 and 60/40 category schedules ending February 2029. No single family payment plan is inferred; obtain the selected unit’s current schedule.
research.handoverNote: Original Phase 7 documents estimate August 2028. Meraas’ 24 September 2026 Phase 7 construction announcement instead anticipates Q2 2028 completion. Phase 10’s own original commercial sheet estimates February 2029. These are different release/time references, so no family-wide date or guaranteed handover is stated.

facts.label: Phase 7 construction scope
facts.value: A 24 September 2026 developer announcement covers 272 homes: 130 four-to-seven-bedroom villas and 142 three-bedroom townhouses. This is Phase 7, not the total community inventory.

facts.label: Phase 10 original payment dates
facts.value: For three-to-five bedrooms: 20% booking; 10% December 2025, 5% June 2026, 10% November 2026, 10% April 2027, 10% September 2027, 10% February 2028, 5% June 2028 and 20% February 2029. For six/seven bedrooms: 20% booking; 10%, 5%, 10%, 5%, 5%, 5% across December 2025 to February 2028, then 40% February 2029.

unresolved: Confirm the exact release, plot, live stock, dated offer and contractual completion before applying any commercial example. A family marketing guide does not establish availability across every release or resale.

Phase 7 plan areas are labelled total area, not plot or net internal area. Its disclaimer excludes depicted swimming pools and landscape features from the supplied works and assigns them to the end user; no private pool inclusion is promised.

Phase 7 original August 2028 and newer Q2 2028 completion references require contract clarification. Portal summaries differ by category and must not override primary schedules. Service charges, plot areas and as-built specifications remain unit-specific.
The official family page mixes plan assets from different releases; no Phase 12 or Phase 10 layout is assigned to Phase 7 examples. Photos remain illustrative.
